manifest.candidate_rationale: The exported candidate is the SELECTION POLICY over {baseline, recent_production_3col ridge, bounded blend}, chosen per position, horizon and quantity on closed inner folds inside the training window and applied by the same function final scoring calls; its outer-fold score is the evidence. recent_production_3col is the candidate arm because it matched or beat served_features on unconditional points in six of eight cells in round 1 and never lost detectably (that was a comparison on outer folds, so served_features stays an exploratory comparison, exported beside the candidate, not part of the policy space).

selection_policy.where: per position, horizon and quantity on closed inner folds inside the training window; applied by the same function final scoring calls

forecast_cutoff.rule: features observed through the feature season; a year-j label trains only when feature_season + j <= last complete season
forecast_cutoff.information_through: end of the 2025 NFL season including postseason

manifest.exposure_definition: games: weeks with a weekly stat row in scope
manifest.event: appeared: >= 1 stat-row game in the season
manifest.composition: e_points_year{j} = p_appear_year{j} x e_points_year{j}_given_appear on the same event and rows; points and games are exactly 0 when absent
manifest.population: every row of the 2025 feature partition of the training file (players with >= 4 stat-row games in 2025, rostered or not)
manifest.intervals: none exported; historical bootstrap intervals are conditional on the fitted models (fit uncertainty), not model or season uncertainty

alignment_check.basis: sum of fantasy_points_ppr over REG+POST vs total_points_t (DG-024 all games)
